gold_references.label: Section 116
gold_references.role: definition and list of kinds of grievous hurt

acceptable_references.label: Section 114
acceptable_references.reason: defines hurt, which is the base category

required_points: Section 116 lists the kinds of hurt designated as grievous: emasculation; permanent privation of the sight of either eye; permanent privation of the hearing of either ear; privation of any member or joint; destruction or permanent impairing of the powers of any member or joint; permanent disfiguration of the head or face; fracture or dislocation of a bone or tooth; any hurt which endangers life or which causes the sufferer to be during fifteen days in severe bodily pain or unable to follow ordinary pursuits.
optional_points: Only these specific kinds of hurt are designated grievous; other hurt falls under Section 114.
forbidden_points: Any injury causing significant pain is grievous hurt.
Grievous hurt requires permanent disability in all cases.

notes: Definition query. Section 116 provides an exhaustive list.
